name: use-subjects
title: useSubjects, useSubject
description: useSubjects and useSubject: the subjects block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the subjects block (`npx better-supabase add subjects`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/repository/record-types.
